statement: Pinned rnconrad device-side emulator interprets an extension register write of 0xAA at offset 0xF0 as enabling encrypted extension communication and 0x55 at 0xF0 as disabling it. This documents a legacy independent emulator's supported host command interpretation, not validation that every retail extension and firmware follows it.

applicability.revision: Historical software emulator; physical Wii extension revision not established
applicability.scope: 0xA4 register write handler lines 405-452; separate from the unencrypted 0x55/0x00 initialization transcript documented in PR16.
